svg.aria-label: Crimson Trace: nine phases of a penetration test, from scoping to retesting.
svg.title: Crimson Trace / Pentest cycle
svg.desc: 01. Scope: Agree on targets, test limits and rules of engagement. 02. Recon: Identify domains, applications and exposed assets. 03. Scan & enumerate: Map services, endpoints and authentication flows. 04. Find weaknesses: Test access controls, inputs and business logic. 05. Validate exploits: Reproduce the flaw; confirm RCE only where it applies. 06. Assess impact: Check privilege escalation and what data is reachable. 07. Clean up: Remove test accounts, files and other test artifacts. 08. Report: Document evidence, risk and a practical fix. 09. Retest: Repeat the test after the fix. Reopen anything still exposed. RCE means remote code execution.
svg.text: Penetration testing, from scope to retest.

g.text: Repeat the test after the fix.
